questions.stem: What is the formula for calculating a moment?

options.text: Moment = force x perpendicular distance from the pivot

questions.explanation: A moment is calculated as: Moment = Force x perpendicular distance from the pivot. The SI unit is Newton-metres (N m). The distance must be measured at right angles to the line of action of the force.

questions.stem: A force of 10 N is applied 0.3 m from a pivot. What is the moment?
questions.explanation: Moment = Force x distance = 10 N x 0.3 m = 3 N m.
